verdict.rationale: incident.io documents user-configurable Workflows that act automatically on incident events, such as auto-publishing to status pages. Investigations start autonomously when an incident is declared, gather context across the stack, and re-assess as new signals arrive, within user-set bounds. Bidirectional ticket sync and auto-creating incidents from monitors add further background automation. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the Workflows builder (triggers, conditions, actions); independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous runs.
